description: FREE, NO KEY: Retrieve an honest compact historical-change brief for one auto-selected fixed GOV.UK page. Includes observed fingerprints, timestamps and bounded added/removed wording where supported. GOV.UK remains authoritative. A human must approve paid checkout.
